subject.title: fix: make auto-review and PR triage fail safely

question: Should maintainers accept the stricter fail-closed PR automation behavior after the final exact-head checks and runtime proof confirm that valid pending/no-required-check responses remain usable while unsafe evidence cannot advance preparation or merge?
rationale: This change deliberately alters the repository's automation safety boundary; tests establish intended cases, but maintainers must own the operational trade-off between conservative blocking and workflow continuity.

options.title: Confirm and land after final proof
options.body: Accept the stricter gate once exact-head CI completes and redacted runtime evidence shows cancellation and non-ready-artifact rejection end to end.

options.title: Narrow the gate first
options.body: Keep the PR open and reduce any gate that blocks a documented valid maintainer workflow before landing.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land after final proof
recommendation.body: Accept the stricter gate once exact-head CI completes and redacted runtime evidence shows cancellation and non-ready-artifact rejection end to end.
